description: Which law governs which BORME act type: maps registry act types (constitución, nombramiento, ampliación de capital, disolución, concurso...) to the norm and articles that regulate them. Without `acto` returns the full map (about 11 KB); with `acto` one mapping. Use it to answer "what law governs this registry act". Not legal advice.

acto.description: BORME act-type slug to look up one mapping. Omit to get the full act-type to norm map.

name: borme_get_act_map
